name: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi
fullName: Abu Abdullah Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi
description: A pioneering mathematician whose work established systematic methods for solving linear and quadratic equations. The word algorithm is derived from the Latinized form of his name.

name: Ibn al-Haytham
fullName: Abu Ali al-Hasan ibn al-Hasan ibn al-Haytham
description: A pioneering scientist of optics who investigated light, vision, reflection and refraction through systematic experiments. His work became an important foundation for later optical science.

name: Abu Ali al-Husayn ibn Sina
fullName: Abu Ali al-Husayn ibn Abdullah ibn Sina
description: One of the most influential physicians and polymaths of the medieval Islamic world. His Canon of Medicine organized medical knowledge and was studied for centuries.

name: Abu Rayhan Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Biruni
fullName: Abu Rayhan Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Biruni
invention: Advanced Methods of Geodesy and Astronomical Measurement
description: A polymath who made major contributions to astronomy, mathematics, geography and the study of the Earth. He developed sophisticated methods for measuring distances and geographical coordinates.

name: Muhammad ibn Zakariya al-Razi
fullName: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Zakariya al-Razi
invention: Systematic Medical Classification and Clinical Methods
description: A renowned physician and alchemist who emphasized observation and clinical experience. He wrote extensively about diseases, treatments and chemical substances.

name: Abu al-Qasim al-Zahrawi
fullName: Abu al-Qasim Khalaf ibn al-Abbas al-Zahrawi
description: A pioneering surgeon whose encyclopedia of medicine documented numerous surgical procedures and instruments. His work significantly influenced the development of surgery.

name: Jabir ibn Hayyan
description: A major early figure associated with Arabic alchemical and chemical literature. Works attributed to him describe laboratory apparatus, purification and processes involving chemical substances.

name: Ibn al-Nafis
fullName: Ala al-Din Ali ibn Abi al-Hazm al-Qarshi al-Dimashqi
description: A distinguished physician who provided an important description of pulmonary circulation, explaining the movement of blood between the heart and lungs.
majorWorks: Commentary on the Anatomy of the Canon of Avicenna

name: Abu Nasr Muhammad al-Farabi
fullName: Abu Nasr Muhammad ibn Muhammad al-Farabi
description: A major philosopher and polymath who developed influential classifications of knowledge and made important contributions to logic, mathematics, music and philosophy.

name: Nasir al-Din al-Tusi
fullName: Muhammad ibn Muhammad Nasir al-Din al-Tusi
description: A distinguished astronomer and mathematician who established the Maragha observatory and developed mathematical models that became important in the history of astronomy.
